tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by nine different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Former OpenAI researchers say they were fired for prioritising safety, while the company claims an information breach occurred. Still open, per BBC.
Anthropic has introduced new conduct rules banning sustained abuse of Claude, sparking debate on artificial intelligence emotions and moral status. Confirmed by Free Press Journal.
OpenAI's revenue shortfall is causing tech stocks to fall, with SpaceX and Chipotle news driving market moves. Confirmed, per CNBC.
Reported by MLex: the EU has asked 30 or more firms, including OpenAI and Meta, about artificial intelligence law compliance.
Google's Gemini artificial intelligence agent is rolling out to businesses, connecting to enterprise tools and enabling task automation. Reported by Dataconomy.
Free every hour.
